entries.description: Inventoried the current public-facing reusable surfaces under src/Libs and documented the major surface areas in the planning baseline.
Mapped the inventoried surfaces to the user-functionality-notes contract and used the AI router to pressure-test the classification recommendations.
Recorded the session-1 baseline inventory, notes mapping, and initial classification matrix in docs/planning/notes-driven-library-contract-audit.md.
Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; only pre-existing preview SDK and XML-doc warnings remained.
Completed independent external session verification with an Opus review and saved the raw verifier output.
Mapped the major Dabbler library surfaces to concrete src/Apps usage paths across the AcmeCoffeeOnline web app and supporting registrations.
Confirmed that template-seed currently assumes the AI workflow assets only and does not directly consume Dabbler UI, report, or security library surfaces.
Updated docs/planning/notes-driven-library-contract-audit.md with the Session 2 consumption map and router-backed evidence summary for proven versus speculative surfaces.
Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully; only the existing preview SDK message and pre-existing XML-documentation warnings remained.
Completed independent external session verification with an Opus review, saved the raw verifier output, and received a VERIFIED verdict with only minor non-blocking notes.
